description: This file declares the interface IControllerFactory for creating IPC controller objects within the Rialto project. It includes a factory method and a method to create RPC controllers, and is part of the firebolt::rialto::ipc namespace.

classes.name: IControllerFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating IPC controller objects, providing a factory method and a method to create RPC controllers.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IControllerFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a google::protobuf::RpcController object.
